title: IRGC: The only active route in the Strait of Hormuz is the Iranian route.
text:
IRGC: The only active route in the Strait of Hormuz is the Iranian route."

"🔹An analytical institute in the oil and gas sector: If the United States cedes control of the Strait of Hormuz to Iran, it will transform the country into the most powerful player in the global oil market."
